rationale: All six parties have staked positions in round 1 and there is notable convergence on process (reviewable guarantees, alternative-package-in-lieu-of-closures, proportionate top contribution), but the core substantive gap—whether a quantified labour/attrition package can actually match closure-level savings, and what the guarantee's reopener conditions look like—has not yet been tested with actual numbers. Further rounds are needed to see if concrete figures are produced and whether parties hold or shift once specifics are on the table.
